title: Grade 3 Math — Mon, Jun 09
description: Fractions — Day 1 of 5: What is a fraction? Equal parts
subject: mathematics

questions.question: What is a fraction?
questions.explanation: A fraction represents a part of a whole. When a whole is divided into equal parts, each part is a fraction.

questions.question: For a fraction to work, the parts must be ___.
questions.explanation: All parts must be equal in size. If you cut a cake unevenly, the pieces are not proper fractions of the whole.

questions.question: A pizza is cut into 4 equal pieces. You eat 1 piece. What fraction did you eat?
questions.explanation: 4 equal pieces total. You ate 1. So you ate 1 out of 4 = 1/4.

questions.question: In the fraction 3/5, what does the bottom number (5) tell us?
options: How many equal parts the whole is divided into
questions.explanation: The bottom number (denominator) tells us how many equal parts the whole is divided into.

questions.question: In the fraction 3/5, what does the top number (3) tell us?
options: Parts we have or are talking about
questions.explanation: The top number (numerator) tells us how many parts we are considering.

questions.question: A chocolate bar is cut into 6 equal pieces. Aryan eats 2 pieces. What fraction did he eat?
questions.explanation: Aryan ate 2 out of 6 equal pieces = 2/6.

questions.question: Which picture shows 1/2?
options: A circle with 1 part shaded out of 3
A circle with 1 part shaded out of 2
A circle with 2 parts shaded out of 3
A circle with 3 parts shaded out of 4
questions.explanation: 1/2 means 1 part out of 2 equal parts.

questions.question: A square is divided into 8 equal parts. 3 parts are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
questions.explanation: 3 shaded parts out of 8 equal parts = 3/8.

questions.question: Which fraction means 'half'?
questions.explanation: Half means 1 out of 2 equal parts = 1/2.

questions.question: An orange is divided into 10 equal segments. Priya eats 4 segments. What fraction is left?
The fraction 1/1 means ___.
questions.explanation: 1 out of 1 equal part is the complete whole — 100% of it.

questions.question: A ribbon is cut into 5 equal pieces. Meera takes 1 piece. She has ___ of the ribbon.
questions.explanation: Meera took 1 out of 5 equal pieces = 1/5.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a fraction?
questions.explanation: 5 is a whole number, not a fraction. Fractions have a numerator and denominator separated by a line.

questions.question: A shape has 4 equal parts. 4 parts are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
questions.explanation: All 4 out of 4 parts are shaded = 4/4, which equals the whole (1).

questions.question: Read this fraction: 7/10. What is the numerator?
questions.explanation: In 7/10, the top number is 7. The top number is called the numerator.
